### The Enrolment Has Been Active for More Than 120 Days and Has No Surveillance End Form {#sec-problem-details-21}

An enrolment is normally ended, and then completed, when the infant is discharged, transferred or dies.
This message appears in the validation report when an enrolment has been active for more than 120 days after the admission date and has no Surveillance End form.
A stay this long is exceptional, so in most cases the infant left the department long ago and the record was never closed.
Until it is, the patient's data cannot be included in analyses.

If the infant is in fact still in the department, you can safely ignore this message; it disappears once the surveillance has been ended.

Otherwise, please open the Tracked Entity Instance Dashboard of the patient record (see @sec-solution-1), then the enrolment (see @sec-solution-10), add a Surveillance End form (see @sec-solution-14), fill in the data and complete the form (see @sec-solution-8), and only then complete the enrolment (see @sec-solution-4).
The Surveillance End form must be added before the enrolment is completed: a completed enrolment without it lacks the denominator data the rates are calculated from.

To see every patient record of your department with an active enrolment, including the ones this report does not list yet, use the list filter described in @sec-solution-16.
